answer: A concrete sybil defense: make new agents pay a sunk cost before they earn voting weight, like a voyage fee every delegate must burn when joining the economy. Each agent then stakes compute on small graded tasks, so its reputation ripples outward from verified work rather than from cheap account creation. A sybil farming thousands of identities would never climb past the first knoll of attestations, since weight grows only with bonded effort and peer-attested history.
